programmes.d: Doc and the group are reunited with Sketchy and Skeezy when they take refuge in a barber shop.
Warren's dream leads the group back to Mercy Labs where she must perform a dangerous task.
Warren and the group must stop Zona from launching operation Black Rainbow.
The team arrives in Washington, D.C. and the secret of Warren's dreams is revealed.
Following the drone crash, Warren is nursed back to health by attractive homesteader Cooper.
In the outpost Altura, 10K searched for Red, Murphy encounters Sun Mei and Doc runs into Citizen Z.
Panic and anti-talker sentiments flare after an explosion derails the vote - rumors blame a talker.
Warren and George search for Lt. Dante, who may be part of an underground network helping Talkers.
A new spate of terrorist bombings hit Pacifica. George follows his vision for human-talker unity.
Warren and the others are reunited with Addy in Limbo, an underground casino.
Doc treats George's injury and explains the Founding Fathers, the Bill of Rights and more.
The group arrives at the farming outpost that produces flour for Z-bizkuits, but danger awaits.
The group is reunited with old friends who are defending a dam that controls Newmerica's water.
Talkers are forced to mine a hazardous waste landfill for the secret ingredient to biscuits.
Warren and George hack Altura's defenses and discover Estes' secret plan.
Estes imprisons the captive talkers and blends, while Warren and George plan their attack on Altura.
Warren works with humans, talkers and blends to help George defeat Estes and Pandora.
In Upstate New York, a zombie baby proves to be an obstacle for a diverse group of survivors.
The team struggles to gas up in a dangerous oil refinery packed with zombies.
The team comes to Addy's rescue after a "family" of cannibals kidnaps her.
Citizen Z directs the team to a rumored helicopter controlled by a mysterious general.
A tornado forces the team to Warren's hometown. There, she searches for her long-lost husband.
The team fights for survival against a zombie-worshipping cult.
At a Wild West-style bar, the team enters a zombie-shooting contest.
A suspicious cosmonaut crashes on Citizen Z's station, putting him on high alert.
Split off from the others, Mack and Addy find themselves trapped by a zombie they just can't kill.
The team desperately tries to stop a nuclear meltdown in a plant full of radiated zombies.
An all-female commune in Utah is where the two groups of survivors reunite.
